TechnologyStack.Runtime: None required for repository readers or Markdown-only task authoring
TechnologyStack.Language: GitHub Flavored Markdown; embedded JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, and TSX use task-specific versions
TechnologyStack.Framework: GitHub repository rendering; React examples use task-specific versions

dep.name: github-markdown-renderer
dep.purpose: Render README files, relative links, code fences, tables, and collapsed details sections

constraint.reason: Each task must state any language, React, or browser API version assumptions that affect its solution

tool.name: temporary-validation
tool.value: task-appropriate JavaScript, TypeScript, React, DOM, or browser harness

ContentVocabulary.language-policy: Russian task prose and stable section labels by default; task-specific exceptions require mentor direction.
ContentVocabulary.metadata-labels: Технологии; Тема; Формат; Уровень; Время; Навыки; Предварительные знания; Среда выполнения
ContentVocabulary.technology-policy: Use an existing catalog value such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or React; a new value requires mentor approval.
ContentVocabulary.topic-policy: Use one existing human-readable catalog topic; a new topic requires mentor approval to prevent synonyms.
ContentVocabulary.format-policy: Use exactly Реализация, Отладка, Разбор, or Прогноз вывода.
ContentVocabulary.level-policy: Use Базовый for one direct concept, Средний for combined concepts or meaningful approach choice, and Продвинутый for nontrivial execution models, architecture, state, asynchrony, or competing-solution tradeoffs.
ContentVocabulary.duration-policy: Use a human-readable estimated duration or range in minutes.
ContentVocabulary.skills-policy: Use a concise list of observable skills exercised by the task.
ContentVocabulary.prerequisites-policy: Use none, relative links to existing task cards, or explicit targeted reading; external materials never replace the local prompt, fixtures, starter code, or solution.
ContentVocabulary.environment-policy: Declare every runtime mode, platform, language, framework, or browser-version assumption that can change the expected result.

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-content-format: GitHub Flavored Markdown with relative repository links
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-progressive-disclosure: One details block for theory, one per hint, and one for the solution
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-verification: Strict candidate gates plus task-appropriate temporary execution, type checking, trace review, browser evidence, link resolution, XML validation, and sampled GitHub rendered-view review
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-grace-resolution: Resolve grace from PATH, then fall back to $HOME/.bun/bin/grace before treating the CLI as unavailable.

discouraged-surface.reason: The initial project intentionally has no repository runtime.

PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: catalog generators, site frameworks, and package-manager-based Markdown pipelines

module-level.command: Verify the exact task contract, then obtain task-appropriate evidence through temporary execution, type checking, trace comparison, or browser review.
module-level.focus: Prove both document structure and solution correctness without adding a permanent repository runtime.

wave-level.command: Validate 8-10 accepted cards, or 1-7 in the final incomplete wave; compare canonical metadata with thematic README.md tables, resolve local and external links, and record validation decisions plus mentor wave acceptance in Beads.
wave-level.focus: Prove candidate quality and atomic synchronization across task, catalog, knowledge graph, and evidence changes.

phase-level.command: Run xmllint on docs/*.xml, scan changed files for whitespace and placeholder defects, review the full catalog projection, and inspect GitHub rendering when template or HTML markup changes.
phase-level.focus: Repository-wide structural integrity and student-visible GitHub behavior.

Testing.mocking-policy: Use local fixtures, deterministic adapters, or fake clocks when network, time, or external state would otherwise make the task non-repeatable; do not mock away the behavior being taught.

Observability.required-fields: moduleId, verificationRef, candidateId, candidateRegisterSize, artifactPath, validationDecision, duplicateTarget, evidenceType, checkResult, beadsIssueId, waveId, waveAcceptanceStatus
Observability.stable-anchors: metadata table; Условие; Критерии готовности; Теория; Подсказка N; Решение; Самопроверка
Observability.redaction: Never place secrets, credentials, private student data, or proprietary source material in task cards or evidence.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Ambiguous metadata or environment, duplicate learning goal, missing prerequisite or asset, task/catalog contradiction, unexpected GitHub rendering, unavailable mandatory evidence, or a solution requiring undeclared knowledge.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every task change must report assumptions, validation decision, artifacts changed, checks run, evidence captured, wave-acceptance status, and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: GitHub repository whose root README is the student entry point and whose task directories render self-contained Markdown cards.
